subject: Escalation: Candidate Asha Raman – level & offer delta
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Escalation: Candidate Asha Raman – level & offer delta

Team,

Following up from yesterday's calibration — I need HR support to resolve a fast-closing situation for Asha Raman. She completed interviews last week for IC-Sr (we recommended L4), but recruiting is preparing an L3 offer because the compensation rubric mapped her average interview score into band L3. I disagree with the mapping for two reasons:

- Interviewers flagged system design depth and ownership examples that align with L4 scope (see attached interview notes).
- We have precedent for similar hires who had mixed scores but showed high product impact and were placed at L4.

Candidate timeline: she has a competing offer and expects an answer within a week. If we wait for the usual comp committee cadence, we risk losing her.

Attachments: [attachment: resume_asha_raman.pdf (PDF, 240KB)], [attachment: interview_notes_asha_raman.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]

Ask: Monica/Laura — can HR either (A) approve an L4 title + L3 base with an accelerated review bump at 6 months and a sign-on, or (B) surface clear rubric evidence that prevents an L4 placement? I can provide a short memo mapping the interview evidence to our leveling rubric if that helps.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Staff Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference

---
On Thu, Dec 3, 2026 at 08:45 AM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick note: candidate verbally expressed urgency — deadline Dec 10. I flagged that to Ben earlier.
>
> - Neha
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Candidate Asha Raman – level & offer delta

Ben —

Thanks for the context and the notes. I understand the time pressure. Two quick points:

1) Our current leveling calibration (post-Oct cycle) maps Asha's average interviewer band into L3. That calibration was applied across the board to reduce inflation.
2) We can consider exceptions for demonstrated scope/impact, but exceptions require either (a) a filled leveling justification form with manager evidence, or (b) an expedited people committee review for hires with competing-offer timelines.

Please fill the attached leveling_justification_template.pdf with concrete examples (owner of X, shipped Y, cross-team dependencies) and include the relevant interview quotes. If you can get that to me by EOD tomorrow, I will escalate to the people committee and request a same-week review. If not, recruiting will need to present an L3 offer to avoid losing the candidate.

I also want to flag equity budget constraints for L4 placements in this quarter — approval may be partial (e.g., title L4 but capped equity at L3 band). I will include that in my note to the committee.

Att: [attachment: leveling_justification_template.pdf (PDF, 60KB)]

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Candidate Asha Raman – level & offer delta

Monica — attaching the completed template and a short one‑page memo mapping interview evidence to L4 expectations. Highlights:

- Ownership & scale: Asha led architecture for a consumer-facing ML pipeline at Hummingbird Labs with cross-team ownership, latency SLAs, and on-call responsibilities (see interview quote, p.2).
- Scope evidence: multiple interviewers called out that her design tackled multi‑team coordination and introduced measurable product KPIs.
- Past hires: attached two anonymized examples where we made exception and promoted at 6 months; outcomes were positive.

Proposed compromise for speed: offer L4 title + L3 base pay, 10% one-time discretionary sign-on, and a guaranteed leveling review at 6 months with potential base/equity adjustment if expectations met. This keeps comp budget predictable while matching title to scope.

Attachments: [attachment: leveling_justification_filled.pdf (PDF, 110KB)], [attachment: leveling_memo_asha.pdf (PDF, 90KB)]

If we can get an expedited people committee OK, I recommend we present the offer with the 6-month review clause included in the offer letter.

-Ben
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate timeline and DocuSign prep

Quick update — Asha confirmed another finalist has advanced to final-stage and she expects an offer by EOD Dec 9. She asked us to respond by Dec 7 if possible.

I've drafted two offer variants in Greenhouse: 1) L3 base + standard equity, 2) L4 title + L3 base + 10% sign-on + 6‑month leveling review. I can push either to DocuSign once I get HR's sign-off.

DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/en/recipient/ABCDEF
Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.company/candidates/ASHARAMAN-12345

-Neha
Senior Recruiter
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Asha Raman — provisional approval and offer instructions

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the thorough evidence, Ben. After an expedited review with the people committee this morning, we're approving a provisional L4 placement for Asha with the following constraints:

- Title: Senior Engineer (L4)
- Base salary: L3 band (mid), with a one-time discretionary signing bonus equal to 10% of target base
- Equity: capped at L3 allocation this quarter (we'll revisit for Q1 refresh)
- Written: guaranteed leveling review at 6 months with objective success criteria documented in the offer

Neha — please send the L4-title variant to Asha in DocuSign with the leveling-review language in section 5. HR will follow up with the candidate to explain the equity constraint, and Laura will own the 6-month success criteria.

Attached: [attachment: approved_offer_asha_raman.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]

We'll loop in Legal if the candidate requests structural changes. Good job moving quickly on this.

—Monica
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
